written.description: Rules on whether an agent skill is malicious, with a model judge whose catch and false-positive rates are published against a labelled test set. A team picks a policy and suppresses known findings, so the same skill gets the same verdict on every run.

alive.last_commit_message:
ci(homebrew): least-privilege workflow token and a pull-requests write guard (#249)

* ci(homebrew): open the formula pull request automatically, scoped

With the repository setting that lets GITHUB_TOKEN open pull requests,
update-homebrew opens its chore/homebrew-formula-<version> pull request
itself. That setting is repository-wide, so keep the write it enables narrow:

- update-homebrew is read-only by default; only the commit-formula job can
  write contents, pull requests and actions.
- A test fails if any job outside an allowlist (that job and the
  detection-impact comment job) holds pull-requests: write, or if any
  workflow uses write-all.
- Pushes and pull requests made with GITHUB_TOKEN start no workflows, so the
  job dispatches the required unit tests on the formula branch, and
  python-tests.yml accepts workflow_dispatch.

The main ruleset still requires a code-owner approval, so the bot cannot
approve its own pull request into main.

* docs: the Homebrew formula pull request is still opened by hand

The cisco-ai-defense organization does not allow GitHub Actions to create
pull requests, so the release step opens it from the printed compare link.
